provenance_detail: Letterforms authored by the project owner from the owner's OWN custom font; outlines extracted from that font with fontTools. The font is the owner's own work - not Nintendo's, not Rare's, not a third party's, and not ROM-derived. Crosshair generated procedurally. Colour ramp authored from seven colour stops, NOT resampled from any ROM texture. No ROM vertex, pixel or display-list data is present. Metrics below were MEASURED from the original prop; they are proportions, not asset data.
normals: AUTHORED. Flat geometry at z=0 with ny ramped linearly with height (-0.290..+0.290) so G_TEXTURE_GEN samples the ramp vertically. Reproduces the original mechanism, measured at corr(ny,height)=+0.948, ny -0.287..+0.289.

materials.note: unlit; colour comes from the ramp sampled by the vertex normal
